title: CatalogSignature
description: A catalog index's signature file, next to the index as <index>.sig (catalog.json.sig, nova-catalog.json.sig) (FR-049, docs/08 §7, ADR-097 D2). digest is the hex SHA-256 of the index file's exact bytes; signature is Ed25519 by publisher over the UTF-8 bytes of "nova-catalog-v1\n" + digest, so it can never pass for a bundle's signature ("nova-extension-v1\n", extension-signature.json). A catalog that pins a key (plugins.catalogs[].publisherKey) verifies only with that key, and a missing signature file is then invalid; without a pin a good signature by a key outside plugins.trustedPublishers is untrusted. An invalid signature refuses the whole catalog. Mirrors signatureFileSchema in packages/core/src/market/signing.ts.
